name: Way of the Four Elements
description: A monk who bends the four elements to their will, casting elemental disciplines fueled by ki instead of spell slots.
note: No new named feature at 6th/11th/17th — Disciple of the Elements is the ONLY feature this subclass grants; those levels just add another known elemental discipline (see known_count_by_level below) via the same feature's own swap-on-level-up text, matching how the class's own confirmed real structure works (verified 2026-09-04).
